chunks: Al-Husayn b. Ahmad (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. Isa from al-Hasan b. Mahbub from Jamil b. Salih from al-Fudayl b. Yasar from al-Sadiq Ja'far b. Muhammad (peace be upon them both). He said:
The memorizer of the Quran who acts by it is with the noble, righteous [angelic] scribes.

key_terms.السفرة الكرام البررة: the noble, righteous scribes — a Quranic phrase (80:15-16) referring to the recording angels

ai.seo_question: What is the status of a Quran memorizer who acts upon its teachings?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq, the sixth Imam, states that a person who memorizes the Quran and lives according to its teachings will be in the company of the angels described in Quran 80:15-16 as 'noble scribes' (safara kiram barara). This hadith emphasizes that mere memorization is insufficient; one must also practice the Quran's teachings to attain this exalted spiritual rank alongside the angelic scribes.
word_analysis: may Allah have mercy on him
